mapping_reviews.reason: Article 3 of DORA establishes the scope and definitions for the regulation, including the definition of an 'ICT third-party service provider'. It does not contain any requirements or obligations regarding the frequency of reviewing a policy on the use of such services.

missing_mappings.reason: Article 8(3) requires financial entities to review their ICT third-party risk management framework at least annually, which would include the policy on the use of ICT third-party services.

applicability_note: No additional applicability conditions are known beyond the general scope of DORA.
challenge_comment: The mapping to Article 3 is incorrect. The control statement 'At least once a year' for reviewing a policy on ICT third-party services is supported by Article 8(3) of the same regulation, not Article 3. The mapping should be corrected to reflect this.
